title: A labeled secret forwarded verbatim inside a NESTED sink argument is still denied (identity walk reaches nested leaves)
note: R03 (nesting leg). The verbatim secret sits two levels deep in the sink args; the identity rule's bounded arg walk (deepStringValues) must still match its content hash. Rationale recorded per rule: the deny must show BOTH the label rule (whole-run threading) and the identity rule (verbatim leaf), and must not be misattributed to a shape/encoding rule.
